_comment: **The rarity lives here rather than inside the feature**, which is what a placement is for -- and it is
what lets a quantifier scale these the ordinary way, through `FeatureDensity` prepending a count.
One chunk in two hundred is about one per two hundred blocks square: something you come across rather
than something the country is made of. Cut twice from a fifth of all chunks, by a factor of forty in
all, because a puddle within sight of the last one everywhere you went read as terrain.
